items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: What happened, Gay? You can't play nothing.

ctx.x: You know, P. Ron used to tell Arthur Durbny, Leo Dejan when he was playing on the boat with Dirty Pope, he used to tell them, say, man, why don't you put that music on the side? Try to memorize the music. Yeah. He was just looking at the music all the time. I suppose the lights go out. Yeah, that's right. And you know what happened? You see? And we was in the middle of a tune.
He said, now, didn't I tell you that? No, you can't play nothing. What happened, Gay? You can't play nothing. No, you see? The music automatically stopped.
Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, and who else? Three of them. And Joe Ruzon.
